# mtncloud_servicenow_workflow (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud ServiceNow workflow data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_integration" "servicenow_prod" {
  name = "SNOW Production"
}

data "mtncloud_servicenow_workflow" "mtncloud_example" {
  name           = "MTN Cloud Approvals"
  integration_id = data.mtncloud_integration.servicenow_prod.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (Number) The ID of the ServiceNow integration

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the ServiceNow integration
- `name` (String) The name of the ServiceNow workflow
